warning_source: Lt. Gen. Herzi Halevi / IDF Chief of Staff
recipient: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu; Defense Minister Yoav Gallant
progress: Contemporaneous Walla and Times of Israel reporting says Halevi warned Netanyahu that spreading reservist non-service could harm the IDF's operational capacity. This is a concrete military-readiness warning from the serving chief of staff acting professionally, distinct from WARN-17's July warning. Published to Notion at Medium confidence.
gaps: No primary transcript, written warning or official meeting minutes recovered. Do not represent this as Hamas/Gaza-specific or as a prediction of October 7.

warning_source: Community emergency teams / regional councils responding to Ministry of Welfare annual readiness questionnaire
recipient: Ministry of Welfare district/regional emergency-supervision chain; exact pre-Oct senior recipients unresolved
progress: State Comptroller primary audit now confirms the questionnaire was the ministry's annual 2023 Tzachi-readiness instrument: 36 of 41 regional councils and 450 of 714 covered settlements responded; 24% of respondents judged their Tzachi insufficiently prepared and 37% reported no exercise. The audit also states councils should create summary reports and ministry district supervision should discuss actions for below-average teams.
gaps: Still need exact 2023 questionnaire submission dates, summary-report dates/distribution, and proof that material results reached a qualifying senior state/government decision-maker before 7 Oct. Do not infer pre-Oct receipt from the later audit.

warning_source: Local councils, civilian security coordinators (rabbashatzim) and MOD/IDF workstream
recipient: Defense Minister Yoav Gallant / Ministry of Defense / IDF; exact warning source/event unresolved
progress: State Comptroller material documents longstanding settlement-defense and communications gaps and says Gallant had decided before the war to upgrade rabbashatz status. A Dec. 2023 report citing Gallant's office says he ordered staff work on their status upon taking office, headed by Brig. Gen. (res.) Amit Edri. This establishes a prewar institutional workstream, not yet a distinct warning event.
gaps: Recover the prewar instruction/order, committee appointment and contemporaneous submissions from councils/rabbashatz bodies identifying concrete readiness or communications risks and their recipients.

progress: Contemporaneous Times of Israel reporting says Gallant met southern local heads, who presented future challenges and needs relating to strengthening settlement and security; Gallant ordered ministry officials to examine the issues raised.
gaps: Recovered wording is too generic to establish a distinct major-disaster/readiness warning. Recover Defense Ministry statement, meeting minutes, council letters/statements or concrete security needs communicated in the meeting.
